title: Nutty Saudi Arabian Beef Fillet Kebabs
description: A jammy and pillowy Saudi Arabian dish featuring beef fillet, perfect for a cozy dinner, made with diabetic-friendly ingredients and a mortar-pestle-pound method.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a mortar, pound the chopped onion, minced garlic, ground cumin, and ground coriander until well combined.
Add the chopped almonds to the mortar and pound until coarsely chopped.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef fillet cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Thread the beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 130 degrees.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional chopped almonds if desired.
